title: Lean-solvent solid electrolytes for safer and more durable lithium batteries: a crucial review
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05293E, Review Article
Chenyu Xiong, Yuefeng Meng, Yao Wang, Bingyue Ling, Mengyu Ma, Hao Yan, Feiyu Kang, Dong Zhou, Baohua Li
This review thoroughly examines the impact of lean-solvent solid electrolyte (LSEs) on for safer and more durable lithium batteries. It also provides a comprehensive overview of existing LSEs.
